rule: All physical results UNVERIFIED until exact flashed SHA, observer, calibrated measurement, proof and independent release-gate acceptance.

sessions.title: Outputs, geometry, frame timing and power
Status, STOP and effect optical observations
BLE, Android and Studio operator acceptance
NVS, OTA, rollback and negative security tests

cases.operator_cue: With LED +12V off, use only a previously electrically qualified isolated PC817 stimulus; step 0,1,2,3,12,14,15,31,224,255 and single bits
cases.additional_dependency: external electrically isolated/rated stimulus board for automatic masks; scope for edge proof

cases.operator_cue: Cue Park, then Brake+Park, then release; record normalized GPIO, debounced mask and physical red
cases.additional_dependency: qualified isolated opto stimulus; camera for emitted color

cases.operator_cue: Cue left+right hazards (12), then brake+hazards (14); record both physical sides
cases.additional_dependency: qualified isolated opto stimulus; video or light sensor

cases.operator_cue: Start an authorized Show, then apply real Reverse; capture both assigned and unaffected zones
cases.additional_dependency: qualified isolated input and optical frame capture

cases.operator_cue: Keep Show running, hold real trigger in one zone and release; verify other zone never resets
cases.additional_dependency: synchronized pixel/video captures for actual optical confirmation

cases.operator_cue: Stimulate externally isolated physical edge while capturing GPIO input and LED DI on calibrated scope
cases.additional_dependency: logic analyzer/oscilloscope with shared timebase and appropriate safe probes

cases.operator_cue: Record live configured pixel counts and watch two unequal physical strips independently
cases.additional_dependency: scope/logic analyzer recommended for electrical lane isolation

cases.operator_cue: After rated fuse/conductor/supply review, instrument real 623+623 pixels and record all pixels
cases.additional_dependency: rated 12V branch harness/injection, calibrated current measurement, scope/logic analyzer; do not assume 20 A sufficient

cases.operator_cue: Read existing outputs; only with an authorized backed-up config, manually try arbitrary 40/17 lengths
cases.additional_dependency: software capture now; actual LED boundary optical video; must not overwrite saved profile

cases.operator_cue: Record GRB red/amber/white at safe current-limited brightness; measure actual current
cases.additional_dependency: rated meter or qualified technician; verified rated supply/termination and optical capture

cases.operator_cue: Read frame counters and measured_fps repeatedly at two approved profile loads
cases.additional_dependency: scope for actual DI timing/jitter; qualified power and thermometer for physical throughput

cases.operator_cue: Record startup, Wi-Fi, connected, disconnected, Show and true fault using phone video
cases.additional_dependency: calibrated light sensor/timer if numeric timing/color acceptance is required

cases.operator_cue: With authorized bench Show and real inputs, trigger STOP and observe fresh output + input restoration
cases.additional_dependency: camera for photons; true physical STOP needs qualified LED wiring

cases.operator_cue: Capture Event Horizon last color and Singularity Shutdown terminal black on physical pixels
cases.additional_dependency: camera / optical measurement and separate trigger observation

cases.operator_cue: Record physical capture and compare exported CORE logical RGB snapshot with source oracle
cases.additional_dependency: Android authenticated BLE export or protocol-controlled capture, synchronized optical capture; no true parity from a status counter

cases.operator_cue: Phone reconnect using stored owner key; record GATT behavior and readback; do not unpair unnecessarily
cases.additional_dependency: phone GATT logging / optional BLE sniffer for packet timing and RF diagnostics

cases.operator_cue: Compare locked reference and Studio browser screens; capture Layout, Triggers, Effects, Sequences
cases.additional_dependency: browser automation/screenshot comparison only after approved reference and Chrome test environment

cases.operator_cue: Compare all six native screens against exact user-approved reference and exercise authorized BLE STOP
cases.additional_dependency: phone screenshot/recording tool; physical LED observation separate

cases.operator_cue: Back up NVS and identify old revisions; reboot only with isolated bench safety before comparing active/staged readback
cases.additional_dependency: esptool read_flash setup, reversible saved-profile fixtures and controlled power interruption

cases.operator_cue: With NVS backed up and independent lamps retained, compare pre/post migration partitions and profiles
cases.additional_dependency: known-good legacy image + migration images and recovery-safe flash procedure

cases.operator_cue: On isolated bench only, prove valid OTA and verified rejected/rolled-back image without loss of safety path
cases.additional_dependency: two verified firmware images, power-cycle/test jig and independent safety lamps

cases.operator_cue: Use non-destructive invalid request/auth fixtures first; log rejection and unchanged NVS
cases.additional_dependency: isolated AP/test client; controlled invalid image/negative flash test only after backup
